description.zh:
返回结果显示的语言。取值：

- zh-CN：中文

- en-US（默认值）：英文
description.en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh-CN: Chinese

- en-US (default): English

description.zh:
按照探测节点IP地址的类型进行精确搜索：

- IPv4：当探测的目标地址类型为IPv4地址时适用。

- IPv6：当探测的目标地址类型为IPv6地址时适用。
description.en:
The IP version of the detection points. An exact search is performed. Valid values:

- IPv4: This version is applicable when the target address is an IPv4 address.

- IPv6: This version is applicable when the target address is an IPv6 address.

description.zh: 健康探测模板的名称，按照输入的关键字进行模糊搜索。
description.en: The name of the health check template. A fuzzy search is performed based on the keyword that you enter.

description.zh: 当前页数，起始值为1，默认为1。
description.en: The current page number. The value starts from 1. The default value is 1.

description.zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值**100**，默认为**20**。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page for a paged query. The maximum value is **100**. The default value is **20**.

description.zh:
按照探测协议类型进行精确搜索：

- ping

- tcp

- http

- https
description.en:
The protocol used for detection. An exact search is performed. Valid values:

- ping

- tcp

- http

- https

title.zh: 搜索健康检查模板列表

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns search-cloud-gtm-monitor-templates --accept-language zh-CN --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --name IPv4-Ping --ip-version IPv4 --protocol ping --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns SearchCloudGtmMonitorTemplates --region cn-hangzhou --PageSize 20 --PageNumber 1 --IpVersion IPv4 --AcceptLanguage 'zh-CN' --Protocol ping --Name 'IPv4-Ping'
